features.description: Add the standalone top-level `default Type.field = expr` declaration, its positioned AST node, parser recovery, and structural anchor validation for named closed non-parameterized record aliases.
acceptance_criteria: Valid default declarations parse and round-trip through AST printing and parser goldens
Malformed declarations produce stable coded diagnostics without panics or cascades
Unknown types/fields, duplicate anchors, open aliases, non-record types, and parameterized anchors are rejected
Existing parser suites remain green

features.description: Resolve anchors, type/effect-check each default at its declaration site, and lower it to a deterministic hidden module binding without evaluator fallback behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Defaults are checked against the exact declared field type and closed effect row
Type mismatch and effect widening fail at the declaration site
Valid defaults lower to collision-proof deterministic hidden bindings
No evaluator change is needed to declare a default

features.description: Complete contextually typed closed-record literals with registered defaults during elaboration and record every insertion in a deterministic trace while preserving existing missing-field behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Override-only literals elaborate to full closed records equivalent to handwritten literals
Explicit fields win and missing required fields retain the existing diagnostic
Nested, return, let-annotated, and argument construction sites are covered
Open rows, subsumption, ADT records, and full literals do not regress
Trace output deterministically names each inserted anchor and binding

features.description: Export default metadata and hidden bindings through package interfaces, round-trip them through caches, include semantic default changes in interface digests, and prove cross-module completion with warm/cold cache tests.
acceptance_criteria: Imported ABI defaults complete consumer literals identically with warm and cold caches
Default metadata and binding types survive interface JSON/cache round trips
Adding, removing, or changing a default invalidates the interface digest
Malformed metadata or missing hidden bindings fail loudly
KRow and RowVar serialization paths have explicit regression coverage

features.description: Ship a runnable override-only record example, update language/versioning documentation, execute record compatibility fixtures, and run repository quality gates.
acceptance_criteria: examples/record_defaultable_fields.ail checks and runs
The four design-doc record regression fixtures remain green
Language docs explain syntax, construction-only semantics, restrictions, tracing, and ABI versioning
make fmt, make test-core, make test, make lint, make check-boundaries, and example verification pass or independently reproduced pre-existing failures are documented
Motoko scaffolder changes remain an explicit post-release follow-up
